sentences.en: esneseq puv • junos eut ul suod saisna eui jo euo ewoseq o papuedxe weyuew jeui padoje/ep spurn lie Jo sjejew jo, peou snopuewen, e usum uounjone y leusnpu, out mun ZLO †,usem )! ubnou, 'Aqueau paieno sip SeM un 'obe suea^ 006 1noqe 'ueym eJay pays! qese † }SeL Audioscripts someone to produce a company brochure, and I wanted to get some business experience because I'm interested in a career in occupational psychology in It business environment.
sentences.zh: esneseq puv • junos eut ul suod saisna eui jo euo ewoseq o papuedxe weyuew jeui padoje/ep spurn lie Jo sjejew jo, peou snopuewen, e usum uounjone y leusnpu, out mun ZLO †,usem )! ubnou, 'Aqueau paieno sip SeM un 'obe suea^ 006 1noqe 'ueym eJay pays! qese † }SeL Audioscripts 有人负责制作公司宣传册，而我想获得一些商业实践经验，因为我对在企业环境中从事职业心理学相关的职业感兴趣。

sentences.en: It was good because I had overall responsibility for the project.
sentences.zh: 这很好，因为整个项目由我全权负责。

sentences.en: TIM: What kind of skills do you think you developed on the placement? mean, apart from the ones you already had ...
sentences.zh: TIM：你认为实习期间你发展了哪些技能？我是说，除了你原本就具备的那些技能之外……

sentences.en: Did you have to do all the artwork for the brochure, the layout and everything?
sentences.zh: 你需要亲自完成宣传册的所有美术设计、版式排版等全部工作吗？

sentences.en: LAURA: We hired the services of a professional photographer for that.
sentences.zh: LAURA：我们聘请了一位专业摄影师来负责这部分工作。

sentences.en: I did have to use my IT skills to a certain extent because cut and pasted text from marketing leaflets, but that didn't involve anything hadn't done before.
sentences.zh: 我的确在一定程度上运用了我的信息技术技能，比如从市场营销传单中剪切并粘贴文字内容，但这些操作都是我之前已经做过的，并未涉及任何新技能。

sentences.en: TIM: Do you think you got any better at managing your time and prioritising & 22 things?
sentences.zh: TIM：你觉得你在时间管理和任务优先级排序方面有所提升吗？

sentences.en: You always used to say you had trouble with that ...
sentences.zh: 你以前总说自己在这方面有困难……

sentences.en: LAURA: Oh, definitely.
sentences.zh: LAURA：哦，绝对是的。

sentences.en: There was so much pressure to meet the project deadline.
sentences.zh: 当时面临巨大的压力，必须赶在项目截止日期前完成所有工作。

sentences.en: And I also got better at explaining things and asserting my opinions, & 22 because I had to have weekly consultations with the marketing manager and give him a progress report.
sentences.zh: 此外，我在清晰表达观点和坚定陈述自身意见方面也进步显著，因为我需要每周与市场经理进行咨询会议，并向他提交进度报告。

sentences.en: TIM: it sounds as if you got a lot out of it then.
sentences.zh: TIM：听起来你从中获益匪浅啊。

sentences.en: LAURA: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: LAURA：完全正确。

sentences.en: It was really worthwhile ...
sentences.zh: 这次实习真的非常有价值……

sentences.en: But you know, the company benefited too
sentences.zh: 不过你知道，公司也从中受益了。

sentences.en: TIM: Yes, they must have done.
sentences.zh: TIM：是的，他们肯定受益了。

sentences.en: After all, if they'd used a professional advertising agency to produce their brochure instead of doing it in-house, presumably they'd have paid a lot more?
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果他们不选择内部完成，而是委托一家专业的广告公司来制作这份宣传册，那费用无疑会高得多，对吧？

sentences.en: LAURA: Oh, yes. worked it out - it would have been 250 per cent more.
sentences.zh: LAURA：哦，没错。我算过了——费用会高出250%。

sentences.en: And & 24 thought the end result was good, even though we did everything on site.
sentences.zh: 而且，尽管所有工作都是在公司内部完成的，最终成果依然令人满意。

sentences.en: The company has quite a powerful computer and managed to borrow some scanning software from the university.
sentences.zh: 公司配备了一台性能较强的电脑，并且还从大学借用了部分扫描软件。

sentences.en: The new brochure looks really professional; it enhances the image of the company straight away. & 24
sentences.zh: 新版宣传册看起来非常专业，立刻提升了公司的整体形象。

sentences.en: TIM: So in the long run it should help them to attract clients, and improve their sales figures?
sentences.zh: TIM：那么从长远来看，这应该有助于他们吸引客户并提高销售业绩？

sentences.en: LAURA: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: LAURA：正是如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: TIM: Well, all in all it sounds very positive - I think I will go ahead and apply for a placement myself.
sentences.zh: TIM：嗯，总体而言，听上去非常积极——我想我也该着手申请实习岗位了。

sentences.en: How do I go about it?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么做呢？

sentences.en: LAURA: It's easy enough to do, because there's a government agency called STEP - S-T-E-P that organises placements for students.
sentences.zh: LAURA：操作起来其实很简单，因为有一个名为STEP（S-T-E-P）的政府机构专门负责为学生安排实习岗位。

sentences.en: You should start by getting their booklet with all the details - I expect you can download one from their website.
sentences.zh: 你应该先获取他们的详细说明手册——我想你可以直接从其官网下载。

sentences.en: TIM: Actually, they've got copies in the psychology department - I've seen them there.
sentences.zh: TIM：实际上，心理学系办公室里就有现成的册子，我之前见过。

sentences.en: I'll just go to the office and pick one up.
sentences.zh: 我这就去办公室拿一本。

sentences.en: LAURA: Right.
sentences.zh: LAURA：好的。

sentences.en: And then if I were you, after I'd looked at it I'd go over all the options with someone
sentences.zh: 然后，如果我是你的话，在阅读完手册后，我会和别人一起仔细梳理所有可选方案。

sentences.en: TIM: I suppose I should ask my tutor's advice.
sentences.zh: TIM: 我想我应该征求一下我的导师的意见。

sentences.en: He knows more about me than anyone.
sentences.zh: 他对我的了解胜过任何人。

sentences.en: LAURA: One of the career officers would be better, they've got more knowledge about the jobs market than your personal tutor would have.
sentences.zh: LAURA: 职业指导办公室的一位职业顾问会更合适，他们对就业市场的了解远超你的个人导师。

sentences.en: TIM: OK
sentences.zh: TIM: 好的。

sentences.en: LAURA: And then when you know what you want you can register with STEP - you'll find their address in the booklet.
sentences.zh: LAURA: 然后，当你明确自己想要什么之后，就可以在STEP注册——他们的地址在手册里。

sentences.en: And once you've registered they assign you to a mentor who looks after your application.
sentences.zh: 一旦你完成注册，他们就会为你指派一名导师，负责跟进你的申请。

sentences.en: TIM: And then I suppose you just sit back and wait till you hear something?
sentences.zh: TIM: 那么，接下来我就只需静候佳音，坐等消息了，是吗？

sentences.en: LAURA: They told me at the careers office that it's best to be proactive, and get updates yourself by checking the website for new placement alerts.
sentences.zh: LAURA: 职业指导办公室的人告诉我，最好采取主动，自行登录网站查看最新的实习岗位通知，以获取最新动态。

sentences.en: Your mentor is supposed to keep you informed, but you can't rely on that.
sentences.zh: 你的导师理应让你及时了解进展，但你不能完全依赖这一点。

sentences.en: TIM: don't suppose it's a good idea to get n touch with companies directly, is it?
sentences.zh: TIM: 直接联系公司恐怕不是个好主意，对吧？

sentences.en: LAURA: Not really ..
sentences.zh: LAURA: 的确不太合适……

sentences.en: But it is the company who notifies you if they want you to go for an interview.
sentences.zh: 但若公司有意邀请你参加面试，将由该公司直接通知你。

sentences.en: You get a letter of invitation or an email from personnel departments.
sentences.zh: 你会收到来自人事部门的邀请函或电子邮件。

sentences.en: TIM: And do I reply directly to them?
sentences.zh: TIM: 那我需要直接向他们回复吗？

sentences.en: LAURA: Yes, you do.
sentences.zh: LAURA: 是的，你需要。

sentences.en: STEP only gets involved again once you've been made a job offer.
sentences.zh: 只有当你获得工作录用通知后，STEP才会再次介入。

sentences.en: TIM: Right ..
sentences.zh: TIM: 明白了……

sentences.en: So, once you've had an interview you should let your mentor.
sentences.zh: 所以，面试结束后，你应该告知你的导师。

sentences.en: know what the outcome is?
sentences.zh: 告知面试结果？

sentences.en: I mean whether you're offered a job, and whether you've decided to accept it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是否获得了工作录用，以及你是否决定接受这份工作？

sentences.en: LAURA: That's right.
sentences.zh: LAURA: 没错。

sentences.en: They'll inform the careers office once a placement has been agreed, so you don't have to do that.
sentences.zh: 一旦实习岗位确定下来，他们会通知职业指导办公室，因此你无需另行通知。

sentences.en: TIM: Is that all then?
sentences.zh: TIM: 就这些了吗？

sentences.en: LAURA: More or less.
sentences.zh: LAURA: 基本上就这些了。

sentences.en: Only once you've accepted an offer you'll probably have to supply a reference, because the placement will be conditional on that.
sentences.zh: 不过，只有在你接受了录用通知之后，才可能需要提供推荐信，因为实习岗位的最终确认通常以此为前提。

sentences.en: And that's something you should ask your own tutor to provide.
sentences.zh: 而推荐信应由你自己的导师来出具。

sentences.en: He knows about your academic ability and also about your qualities, like reliability.
sentences.zh: 他既了解你的学术能力，也清楚你的个人品质，比如可靠性。

sentences.en: TIM: Well, thanks very much for the information - I'm starting to look forward ...
sentences.zh: TIM: 好的，非常感谢你提供的信息——我现在已经开始期待了……
